svg.title: A dry umbrella icon stays on-screen while canal water lifts a plastic cup.
svg.desc: A thin sheet of water enters the lane and raises a discarded unbranded cup. Above it, the flood dashboard still shows a dry umbrella beneath a cloudless sky.
svg.text: Page 41, panel 5 · Ground-level comic close-up beside the lane dashboard

text.tspan: Observed water reaches the road while the rain-based
dashboard continues to display no flood.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
